+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def _extract_text(labels: Any) -> str:
+    if labels is None:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(labels, str):
+        return labels
+    if isinstance(labels, dict):
+        for key in ("text", "label", "name", "description", "caption"):
+            value = labels.get(key)
+            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+                return value
+        parts: List[str] = []
+        for value in labels.values():
+            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+                parts.append(value)
+        return " ".join(parts)
+    if isinstance(labels, (list, tuple, set)):
+        return " ".join(_extract_text(item) for item in labels if _extract_text(item))
+    return str(labels)
+
+
+def _normalize_response(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    result = data.get("results", [{}])[0] if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
+    categories = result.get("categories", {}) if isinstance(result, dict) else {}
+    category_scores = result.get("category_scores", {}) if isinstance(result, dict) else {}
+    flagged = bool(result.get("flagged", False)) if isinstance(result, dict) else False
+    unsafe_categories = [name for name, is_flagged in categories.items() if bool(is_flagged)]
+    return {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL,
+        "flagged": flagged,
+        "unsafe_categories": unsafe_categories,
+        "category_scores": category_scores,
+        "raw": data,
+    }
+
+
+def check_generated_visual_labels(labels: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, timeout: float = 30.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:

+            "provider": "openai",
+            "model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL,
+            "flagged": False,
+            "unsafe_categories": [],
+            "category_scores": {},
+            "raw": {"results": []},
+        }
+
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, "input": text},
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return _normalize_response(response.json())

+

+    return {

+                "role": "system",

+            },

+                "role": "user",

+                    f"Translate this image description{source_clause} into {target_language}. "
+                    f"Return only the translated text.\n\nDescription: {text}"
+                ),
+            },
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def translate_alt_text(text: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",

+        json=_build_payload(text, target_language, source_language),
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+
+

+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Translate generated image descriptions")

+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": _load_image_content(image_path),
+                "features": [{"type": "SAFE_SEARCH_DETECTION"}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }

+        raise SystemExit("Usage: score_image_safety.py IMAGE_PATH")

+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY is required")
+

+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": _load_image_content(image_path=image_path, image_bytes=image_bytes)},
+                "features": [{"type": "TEXT_DETECTION"}],
+            }

+import base64
+import json
+import os

+from typing import Any, Dict, List
+

+
+
+API_URL = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def _load_image_content(image_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if image_path.startswith("http://") or image_path.startswith("https://"):
+        return {"source": {"imageUri": image_path}}
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")
+    return {"content": encoded}
+
+
+def detect_image_labels(image_path: str, max_results: int = 10) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": _load_image_content(image_path),
+                "features": [{"type": "LABEL_DETECTION", "maxResults": max_results}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+    response = requests.post(f"{API_URL}?key={api_key}", json=payload, timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    annotations = data["responses"][0].get("labelAnnotations", [])
+    return [
+        {
+            "description": item.get("description"),
+            "score": item.get("score"),
+            "mid": item.get("mid"),
+        }
+        for item in annotations
+    ]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: detect_image_labels.py IMAGE_PATH [MAX_RESULTS]")
+    image_path = sys.argv[1]
+    max_results = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 10
+    print(json.dumps(detect_image_labels(image_path, max_results=max_results), indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
